s: Dine hagbaha veshipshup hayyadayim bintila ubo t"z seipim: seder netila merebiit kak hu: im shopek kol harebiit bepaam achat al shette yadayv keachat, kegon sheacher yotzeq al yadayv, o sheochez hakkeli berashe etzbeotayv veshopek al shette yadayv keechad — nitharu yadayv. Veen tzarik lomar im yesh lo mayim rabbim veshopek rebiit al kol achat bipne atzmah. Abal im ba littol al kol achat bipne atzmah merebiit bilbad — tzarik lishpok al kol achat shette peamim, ki kesheshshopek al hayyad paam achat nitmeu hammayim mehayyad, hoil veen bahem rebiit, shehu shiur tohora bayyadayim, ukesheshshopek shenit metaharim mayim sheniyyim et mayim harishonim veet hayyad. Veachar kak menaggebah bemappa o bedabar acher lehasir harishonim legamre min hayyad, mishshum tohora yetera, lehaomerim shezzehu taam hanniggub, kemo shennitbaer besiman qn"ch:

Veap im niggeb bedabar qasheh sheen hammayim niblaim, kegon sheshshipshepan bakkotel o berosho (apillu besaarotayv, raq shello chikkek bahen, sheaz haya tzarik lachazor velittol, ella sheshshipshep alehem millemala), ap al pi shechozer venogea beme hashshipshup — en yadayv nitmaot mishshum negiatam belachluchit mayim harishonim shehayu temeim, kevan shekkebar nitharu bammayim hashsheniyyim. Veim shapak al kol yad bipne atzmo shetipa achat merubba kishtayim, dehaynu sheyyesh beme shetipa zo kede sheyyimshach kol happereq hatztzarik netilat yadayim shette peamim — nitharu hammayim keillu shapak alehem shette peamim:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheshshapak al kol yad bipne atzmah, abal im shopek al shette yadayv keachat — en shetipa achat moelet letaharan kelal, ella im ken shopek alehen rebiit bebat achat, abal pachot merebiit, ap al pi shehammayim bau mishshiyyure tohora, al derek shennitbaer besiman q"s — enan metaharim shette yadayim keachat ella bishte shetipot, shehammayim hashsheniyyim metaharim et harishonim veet hayyadayim:

Abal hammayim shealehem temeim, vetzarik lenaggeban veachar yokal. Veim shipshepan bedabar qasheh vechazar venaga beme hashshipshup — nitmeu hayyadayim bingiatan belachluchit mayim hattemeim. Veim hitbilan beme miqveh — en tzarik niggub, shehammiqveh metaher mayim hattemeim behashshaqa:

Vekol zeh kesheyyadayv neqiyyot, abal im yesh alehen likluk tit o shear kol dabar hachotzetz — tzarik lishpok alehen g' peamim, rishona lehaabir hallikluk, veachar kak mayim rishonim usheniyyim, o rebiit bebat achat. Umayim sheshshapak rishona nitmeu mehayyadayim, apillu shapak rebiit bebat achat, hoil velo tiharu hayyadayim mippene hallikluk shealehen shechotzetz, vegam mayim rishonim sheacharehem lo tiharu, venitmeu gam hem mehayyadayim, hoil vehammayim sheshshapak rishona lo bau kelal letohorat hayyadayim ki im lehasir hachatzitza. Veap al pi ken enam memaatim et harebiit, sheap im lo nishar bakkeli rebiit keshemmatchil littol mayim rishonim sheacharehem — en bekak kelum, lepi shehammayim sheshshapak rishona hem tzorek hannetila umikkelalah, vekevan shehaya rebiit bakkeli behatchalat netilato — dayyo. (Abal im en al yadayv dabar hachotzetz, ap al pi shehem meluklakot umetunnapot, shetztzarik lehaabir mehem hattinnup bannetila, kol sheeno chotzetz bannetila, kegon shehu lach — dayyo bemah sheober al yede rishonim usheniyyim, o rebiit bebat achat, shehem baim letaher et hayyadayim mittumatan. Veiqqar tumat hayyadayim lo gazeru ella mippene shehem asqaniyyot, veshemma nageu bemaqom metunnap, lekak hitqinu netila letaharan mittinnupan, ella shekkevan sheggazeru alehen tuma — nitmeu mayim harishonim, venitharim al yede sheniyyim[)]:

Tumat hayyadayim vetohoratan enah ella ad happereq hatztzarik netilat yadayim velo chutz lappereq, sheim natal harishonim ad happereq vehashsheniyyim chutz lappereq — lo nitmeu sham, ap al pi shehem sham rishonim, ulepikak, im chazeru lappereq — enan metammein et hayyad. Abal im harishonim shehayu betok happereq venitmeu yatzeu chutz lappereq, ap al pi shennatal gam hashsheniyyim chutz lappereq — lo tiharum sham, ulepikak, im chazeru lappereq — chazeru vetimmeu harishonim et hayyad. Lekak ameru chakamim: hannotel — tzarik sheyyagbiah yadayv lemala, shello yachzeru hammayim shechutz lappereq letok happereq. Umikkol maqom, im notel kol hayyad ad haqqaneh shel zeroa — lo yagbiah kol hayyad legamre, kede shello yetzeu mimmenna mayim al hazzeroa bemaqom sheyyishshaaru sham gam achar sheyyenaggeb yadayv, sheeno menaggeb oto maqom mippene shehu mekusseh bibgadim, veachar kak kesheyyashpil yado leekol bah — yachzeru mehazzeroa leyado vitammeuha, ella yagbiah rashe etzbeotayv, veal yede zeh tehe shear hayyad mugbahat qetzat, shemmehaetzbaot en lachosh sheyyeredu al hazzeroa. Vetzarik lizzaher sheyyihyu mugbahim veomedim missop hannetila ad sheyyenaggeban, sheim yagbihan veyachazor veyashpilan — yachzeru hammayim sheyyatzeu chutz lappereq al yede hagbahato veyashubu letok happereq. Lepikak, yittol shette yadayv keachat, sheim yittol yado achat veyagbihenna veachar kak yishpok bah al hashsheniyya — nimtza moridah lematta kesheshshopek bah. Veim rotzeh lehashpilan mittechillat hannetila shello yetzeu mayim rishonim chutz lappereq kelal mittok happereq — hareshut beyado, raq sheyyashgiach sheyyabo hammayim al rashe haetzbaot. Veim shopek rebiit al kol yad bipne atzmah, o rebiit al shette yadayv keechad, sheen sham mayim temeim kelal — en tzarik lizzaher bazeh kelal. Veen tzarik lomar hammatbil yadayv. Veyesh meporshim mah sheameru chakamim: hannotel tzarik sheyyagbiah yadayv, eno benotel kol hayyad ad haqqaneh shel zeroa, ella benotel haetzbaot lebaddan, ukedibre haomerim shehannetila dayyah ad meqom chibbur haetzbaot lekap hayyad, vetumat hayyadayim larishonim vetohoratan mehashsheniyyim hi ad haqqaneh shel zeroa, lepikak yesh lachosh shemma haleku harishonim chutz limqom chibbur haetzbaot venitmeu sham, ap im lo yatzeu lesham mehaetzbaot, ella haleku lesham mechamat hakkeli, vehashsheniyyim shemma lo haleku bekol maqom shehaleku harishonim venisharu harishonim betumatan, umetammein hayyad im yoredim laetzbaot keshemmashpil yadayv, laken tzarik lehagbiah rashe etzbeotayv lemala missop hannetila ad sheyyenaggeb. Veap im rotzeh lehashpilan mittechillat hannetila — eno moil, ki i epshar letzamtzem littol mammash betok happereq shello yeleku hammayim chutz leetzbeotayv meat, veim haleku lesham — nitmeu sham, ap al pi shello yaredu lesham mehaetzbaot ella mehakkeli. Vehammatbil yadayv o sheshshapak alehem rebiit keechad, apillu shapak al haetzbaot veyatzeu mehen chutz lappereq — lo nitmeu sham kelal kevan shehem me tohora. Veal pi sebara zo nahagu akshav lehaqel behagbahat hayyadayim, lepi shennohagin lishpok al kol yad g' peamim ap shehen neqiyyot, veshub en lachosh shemma lo haleku hashsheniyyim bekol maqom shehaleku harishonim, sheim lo haleku hashsheniyyim — haleku hashshelishiyyim:

Kesheshshopek harishonim al hayyad — tzarik lizzaher velishpok bishpika achat al kol pereq hatztzarik netilat yadayim. Umikkol maqom, en tzarik shepika achat mammash, ella shello yapsiq millishpok ad sheyyaggiu hammayim bekol happereq, sheen yadayim tehorot lachatzain, lepi sheen derek netila bekak. Veim pasaq achar shennatal miqtzat hayyad — en netilat miqtzat zo ola lo (vaapillu shapak rebiit bebat achat — (v)nitmeu hammayim, kevan shello tiharu kelum), vetzarik lachazor velishpok gam al mah shennatal. Veim lo shapak ella al hannishar miyyado shello natal — hare yado temea keshehayeta (apillu im gam shepika zo hayeta rebiit). Veyesh omerim sheim yesh adayin al miqtzat hayyad shennatal topeach al menat lehatpiach — mitztarepet netila zo im mah shehosip venatal hannishar miyyado, shemmashqeh topeach al menat lehatpiach chibbur letohora, vahare zo kintila achat. Veyesh lehachamir kassebara harishona. Vekol zeh barishonim, abal bashsheniyyim — notel miqtzat yado vechozer umosip al miqtzatah hashsheni, vaapillu nitnaggeb miqtzatah harishon:

Achar netilat mayim sheniyyim al shette yadayv, o rebiit bebat achat — yeshapshep yadayv zo bazo. Veim lo natal ella ad meqom chibbur haetzbaot lekap hayyad — yizzaher keshemmeshapshepan zo bazo shello tigga zo bazo bekap hayyad bemaqom shello napelu sham mayim velo nithar, shemmaqom zeh metamme mayim sheal yado hashsheniyya bingiatah bo, vehammayim chozerim umetammein et hayyad, ap al pi shehem mayim sheniyyim. Abal im shapak rebiit bebat achat — en tzarik lizzaher bazeh, shemme rebiit me tohora hem, veenan mittammein. Veyesh omerim shello ameru me rebiit me tohora hem ella bemaqom shehem metaharim, sheaz enan mittammein meoto maqom, kegon im natal rebiit ad meqom chibbur haetzbaot veyatza mishsham lekap hayyad — en hakkap metammeatan, lepi shemmetaharim hem lammaqom shebbau shamma, abal im yad achat temea noga bahem — timatam ap al pi shehem me rebiit. (Veyesh lehaqel bedibre soperim):

Im shipshepan zo bazo achar sheshshapak alehem mayim rishonim pechutim merebiit, apillu shapak al kol achat bipne atzmah shetipa achat merubba kishtayim shennitharu bahen — chazeru venitmeu bingiatan zo bazo. Vaapillu mayim sheniyyim en moilin letaharan, lepi shehammayim sheal yad zo nitmeu bingiatan beme zo vesheal zo bingiat me zo, veen mayim sheniyyim metaharim ella hammayim shennitmeu miyyad zo atzmah shebbau aleha letaharah velo shennitmeu miyyad acheret, vechozerim umetammeim et hayyadayim. Lepikak, tzarik lenaggeban techilla, veyachazor veyittelem karauy. Vaapillu im shapak al achat harishonim usheniyyim, shehammayim shealeha tehorim — chozra venitmea im noga bah chabertah shello shapak aleha ella rishonim bilbad. Vaapillu hayeta shetipa achat merubba kishtayim, shehayyad tehora, mikkol maqom, hammayim temeim metammeim hammayim sheal zo. Umikkol maqom, yesh omerim shemmayim acherim moilim letaharah, kevan shehayeta kebar tehora legamre im hammayim shealeha:

Apillu naga bah yad sheenah netula kelal, ben shehi yado ben yado shel acher shello natal yadayv — hare hammayim shealeha mittammein miyyad hattemea shennoga bahem, vetzarik litten aleha sheniyyim acherim. Veim lo natan aleha ella harishonim bilbad — en lahem taqqana ella beniggub, o behashshaqa leme miqveh. Vegam hayyad sheenah netula en lah taqqana ella beniggub, lepi shennitmea gam ken mimme chabertah hattemeim, veen mayim sheniyyim vaapillu rebiit bebat achat metaharim tuma habbaa mechamat yad acheret (abal im noga bashsheniyyim, shettumatan hi bingiatam — en tzarik lenaggebah). Ukebar nitbaer shebbeme rebiit bebat achat yesh lehaqel velomar sheenan mittammein kelal, ulepikak im shapak al yado achat rebiit bebat achat venoga bah yado hashsheniyya shello shapak aleha kelum — yado harishona tehora (vegam hashsheniyya, ap al pi sheyyesh aleha lachluchit mayim min harishonim, velachluchit zeh shealeha nitmea mimmenna shehare en bo rebiit, mikkol maqom, mittaher hu al yede mayim rishonim usheniyyim o rebiit bebat achat sheyyishpok aleha, kevan shettumatah hi miyyad zo atzmah). Abal im natan al yado hashsheniyya mayim harishonim pechutim merebiit venoga bezo shennatan aleha rebiit bebat achat — nitmea yad zo mimmeme hashsheniyya hattemeim, vetzarik lishpok aleha mayim sheniyyim letaharah, shekkol mayim temeim metammeim et hayyad hannogaat bahem, apillu hi tehora legamre, vaapillu beemtza hasseuda:

Vekol zeh keshennotel yado achat o shettehen kol achat bipne atzmah, abal im metzarep yadayv zo lazo venotel shettehen keachat — hare hen nechshabot keyad achat legamre, veenan metammeot zo et zo bingiatan zo bemayim temeim shealehen mishshetipa harishona, veyakol leshapshepan zo bazo. Venakon haddabar leshapshepan miyyad achar shetipa harishona, kede lirchotz yapeh hazzea qodem sheyyitten alehem mayim sheniyyim letaharan. Lepikak, kol hannotel yadayv merebiit — o yishpok lo acher alehen, o yochaz hakkeli berashe etzbeotayv kede sheyyittol b' yadayv keachat, vishapshepam miyyad achar shetipa harishona, sheim yittol kol achat bipne atzmah — yesh lachosh shemma tigga yad bachabertah qodem sheyyitten mayim sheniyyim al shettehen. Abal im notel kol yad merebiit — en tzarik lachosh lazeh. Vaapillu d' veHashem shehinnichu yedehen zo betzad zo o zo al gabbe zo — keyad achat chashubot, veenan metammeot zo et zo, kemo shennitbaer besiman q"s:

Natal shette yadayv zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah mayim harishonim pechutim merebiit, venimlak keshennatal hammayim hashsheniyyim, vehiggia yadayv zo lazo veshapak al shettehen keachat — yadayv temeot, mippene shekkeshemmetzarep yadayv zo lazo leqabbel mayim hashsheniyyim — nitmeu yadayv bingiatan zo lazo, ki mayim sheal gabbe zo metammeim hammayim sheal gabbe chabertah vegam hayyad atzmah, ukeshennotel et hashsheniyyim — lo tiharu et harishonim, kevan shennitmeu miyyad acheret, ella gam hashsheniyyim nitmeu bahem, vetzarik lenaggeb yadayv velachazor velittelan karauy:

Kol tumat hammayim mehayyadayim enah ella bammayim sheal hayyad bishat netila, sheaz beqal nitmeu hammayim, ben mehayyad atzmah, kegon mayim rishonim, ben miyyad acheret temea, vaapillu hem mayim sheniyyim, abal mayim sheenan al hayyad, ap al pi sheyyadayim temeot nogeot bahem bishat netila — enan metammeot otan, shehare lo aseru litten mayim bechopnayv lachabero ella mippene sheen chopnayv keli, abal lo mishshum shennitmeu hammayim mechopnayv. Veken hayyotze mibbet hakkisse — yakol lishob bechopnayv min haddeli vehammayim hannisharim kesherim lintila. Vaapillu im hannotel atzmo bishat netilato nogea beyadayv hattemeim bammayim sheal hakkeli o shebbetok hakkeli, ben qodem mayim rishonim ben qodem sheniyyim — lo nitmeu miyyadayv. Lepikak, keli shenniqqab beshulayv vetachab bo barza vedocheq otah lemala veyotzeim hammayim al yado, ap al pi shehabbarza meluchlechet bammayim venogea bahem beyado hattemea — lo nitmeu, veyakol lachazor uledochqah beyado hashsheniyya shennetalah barishona al yede dechiqat habbarza beyado harishona shello hayeta netula kelal. Umikkol maqom, tzarik sheyyishpok al kol echad rebiit bebat achat, o shetipa achat merubba kishtayim, shello yitztarek lemayim sheniyyim, o sheyyishpok harishonim usheniyyim al yad zo veachar kak harishonim usheniyyim al yad zo, sheim yishpok harishonim al zo veal zo, veachar kak hashsheniyyim al zo veal zo — nimtza nogea babbarza beyado lacha mimmayim harishonim hattemeim venidbequ mayim temeim babbarza, ukeshechozer vedochaqah beyado hashsheniyya — nitmea mimmayim temeim shennidbequ bah, vetzarik lenaggebah. Veken yizzaher bikli sheen lo ella ozen echad, sheim yochazenna beyado lacha mimmayim temeim — lo yochazenna beyado hashsheniyya. Abal im hayeta haozen meluchlechet bammayim hattehorim, ap al pi shennageu bahem yadayim temeot — en lachosh ligga bahem apillu bishat netila. (Vaapillu mayim sheal gabbe yadayim temeot enan mittammeim ella bishat netilatan laakila, abal mi sheyyadayv meluchlachot bemayim shello bishat netilatan laakila venaga bahen mi shettiher yadayv laakila — yadayv tehorot):

Kesheshshopek mayim rishonim al yadayv — tzarik lizzaher shello yishshaer al yadayv tzeror o qesam o shum dabar acher, lepi sheen mayim sheniyyim metaharim ella mayim sheal gabbe hayyad, velo hammayim sheyyatzeu mehayyad al gabbe tzeror o dabar acher, vechozerim umetammeim et hayyad shehi nogaat bahem. Vaapillu sheleg ubarad usheare debarim shehem mibberiyyat hammayim, kevan sheeno merussaq upasul lintila — en mayim sheniyyim metaharin otan hammayim sheal gabbayv. Veim shopek rebiit mayim keachat al yadayv — en tzarik lizzaher bekak:

Mi sheyyesh lo makka beyado uretiyya aleha veeno yakol lahasirah mechamat keeb hammakka — day lo sheyyittol shear hayyad shello bimqom hammakka. Veen zo netila lachatzain, kevan sheeno yakol littol chetzyah hashsheniyya, vedomeh lemi shenniqta etzbao shennotel shear hayyad. Omnam tzarik lizzaher shello yaggiu hammayim laretiyya, shello yachzeru vitammeu hayyad, umippene sheqqasheh lehizzaher sheyyaggiu hammayim ad haretiyya velo yippelu al haretiyya, laken yishpok rebiit keachat al kol hayyad, sheaz lo nitmeu hammayim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Birtiyya, shebbevadday sopah lahasirah ella sheeno yakol lahasirah akshav, laken enah betela legabbe hayyad (shehare im haya yakol lahasirah matay sheyyirtzeh — haya tzarik lahasirah mishshum chatzitza, veim hayeta betela legabbe hayyad — lo hayeta chashuba chatzitza). Abal debarim sheenan chotzetzin mippene miutan, sheenan maqpidin alehem lahasiran leolam — hare hem betelim legabbe hayyad legamre, veen lachosh lehammayim shealehem sheyyachzeru vitammeu hayyad, lepi shemmayim sheniyyim metaharim mayim shealehem kammayim sheal hayyad atzmah:

Mayim rishonim, dehaynu mayim shellipne hammazon — notelim ben al gabbe kelim ben al gabbe qarqa, sheen ruach raa shora alehem kemo al acharonim shelleachar hammazon. (Veim naga beshopekin sheal gabbe qarqa o bikli, im lo natal rebiit bebat achat — nitmeu yadayv, ap al pi sheshshapak sham gam mayim sheniyyim, sheen mayim sheniyyim metaharim ella mayim sheal gabbe yadayv, velo sheal gabbe qarqa o keli, vaapillu hashsheniyyim merubbim meharishonim, vaapillu hen me rebiit. Velaken mi sheshshoeb bikli qatan mikkeli gadol veochez beyado sepat hakkeli hallacha mimmayim temeim, ap al pi shehitbil meqom achizato beme rebiit kesheshshaab mikkeli haggadol — lo hoil kelum):
